tei:div.tei:p: (763)rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i gsol mchod/ sman btsun mgul rgyan bzhugs/ (764)

rat+na thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma'i mchod gtor dkar zlum pad 'dab bzhi pa rang 'dra'i 'khor bzhi ldan/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ shing tog 'o phud dang bcas pa bshams la/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod du lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod gtor 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad pa'i rang bzhin kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin (765)du gyuraḥ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ru sogs dang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis brlab/ rten bskyed pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun du 'od snang las grub pa'i skyed mos tshal chos bzang lha'i 'dun pa lta bur yid du 'ong zhing blta na sdug pa/ ne'u seng sman ljongs me tog du mas bkra ba'i gnas ri dwags sna tshogs bag phebs par rgyu zhing*/ 'bab (766)chu lhung lhung dang bya skad snyan par sgrog pa/ mtha' skor gangs ri'i ra ba dang*/ ljon shing du mas bkra ba'i dbus su/ bai ḍūr+ya'i khang bzangs shel gyi them skas rim pa gnyis pa dang*/ byi ru'i kha bad can gyi nang du rin po che'i khri dang dar zab 'bol brtsegs kyi steng du yuṃ las sman btsun chen mo rdo rje g.yu'i sgron ma chu shel gyi phung po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu/ dar zab dkar po'i rtse gos gser gyi pad+ma ris dbang po'i tshon cha bkram pa lta bu'i g.yang lug (767)rma bya'i mdongs kyi cha ga can/ phyag g.yas nor bu dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ g.yon pa dngul dkar gyi me long dang mda' dar sna lnga 'jin pa/ shin tu mjes shing 'jo sgog 'jum pa'i nyams can/ dbu la dar thod ljang gu dang gser g.yu me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon bzhir rang 'dra'i mched bzhi dang mtha' skor du gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba'i spyi mgrin snying ga (768)gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa la 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas spyan drangs par gyur/

spyan 'dren ni/ kye/ mdun du gangs ri skyed mos tshal/ dbus na rin chen khang bzangs tshe/ de nang rin chen khri stengs su/ rdo rje g.yu sgron dkar gsal ni/ dar dkar na bza' gser g.yus rgyan/ phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dbang*/ g.yon pa dngul dkar me long 'jin/ dar thod rin chen rgyan phreng can/ 'jum (769)bcas phyed krung 'od zer 'phro/ phyogs bzhir mched bzhi gtso mo 'dra/ kun kyang bcu drug na tshod la/ sgeg mjes dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs/ snying ga'i 'od zair rab 'phros pas/ gnam sman gangs ri lha yi gnasaḥ sprin dkar dag pa'i pho brang nas/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bstim/ hūm̐/ rig 'jin pad+ma thod phreng gis/ bka' nyan chad tho la gnas pa'i/ sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ spyan (770)'dren gnas 'dir da tshur byon/ badz+ra sa mā jaḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ ting 'jin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ snang srid snod bcud ma lus pa'i/ mkho dgu'i 'byor tshogs ji snyed pa/ ye shes bdud rtsir 'char bas bskang*/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyis/ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa dbyings su bskang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dpal nus stobs bskyed/ bde stong rang byung mngon myur stsol/ oṃ badz+ra pra mo ha ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan lnga ma bdun gyis (771) dbul/ rgyas par spro na skong bshags bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'gyur med bde ba chen po'i ngang nyid las/ ting nge 'jin gyis rnam 'phrul bkod pa ni/ dbang po drug la 'dod dgur 'char ba'i rdzas/ 'bru bcud stong las sbyar ba'i zhal skyems dang*/ dkar mngar 'o phud spris mar chags pa'i zho/ chu dang thang las skyes pa'i me tog rigs/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i spos/ nyi zla la sogs snang byed sgron me'i 'od/ bzang drug la 'gros brlan pa'i dri (772)ngad chab/ shing tog rtsi thog g.yos su sbyar ba'i zas/ 'bud dkrol brdung dang glu yi 'gyur khugs sgra/

nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan tshogs kyis bskang*/ phye mar bsang spos dar tshon sna lnga'i sprin/ skyed tshal ma rmos lo tog 'breng g.yag zhol/ thal dkar g.yang mo lug dang tshe tshe ra/ mgyogs pa'i bag dang rdzu 'phrul rlung gi shugs/ rtsal gsum ldan pa'i cang shes dri'u sngon/ sha rkyang ma he 'dod 'jo'i ba dang mjo/ nam mkha' (773)lding dang rma bya zlos gar can/ ngang pa khrung khrung bzhad dang mkha' 'gro'i bya/ gnag snum yan lag dmar dang ser ba sogs/ srog chags mdangs kyis thugs dam bskongs gyur nas/ bya ba spyod lam nyes dang 'bags btsog shor/ rtag gtor rgyun gtor chag dang gsol mchod g.yel/ thab gzhob mi 'khon lha 'khon byung ga sogs/ thugs dang 'gal ba thams cad sor chud nas/ tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub (774)stsal du gsol/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ rdo rje g.yu sgron shin tu mjes pa'i sku/ dkar gsal gangs ri'i ngos la nyi shar 'dra/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ mched lnga 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod/ sngon tshe slob don pad+ma'i spyan snga ru/ ji ltar zhal bzhes thugs dam dran mjod la/ rnal 'byor bdag la dgyes pa'i zhal bzang ston/ bcol pa'i phrin las myur du 'grub par mjod/ spro na mnga' gsol bya ba ni/ (775)kye bde chen kun tu bzang mo'i kai la shar/ rjes chags nyi gzhon 'char ka'i brtul zhugs kyis/ dam por 'khyud pa'i 'jo sgeg lang tshe'inyams/ sman btsun rdo rje g.yu yi sgron mar shar/ mtho ris dbu mo'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar/ lha mo yid 'ong me tog man+da ra/ shin tu mjes pa'i lang tsho'i 'jig rten gyi/ brtan pa 'phrog pa'i byed po khyod las su/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis dag pa'i rten 'brel rtsal/ 'jig (776)rten bstan ma'i snang char bstan mod kyang*/ mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing na wā rā hī/ dngos grub kun gyi byed por mnga' gsol la/ shin tu chags pa chen po'i ye shes mes/

thabs mchog bde ba chen po'i dpa' bo la/ sbyar bas snang srid dbu mar dag pa'i grong*/ sa lam yongs bgrod pho nyar mnga' gsol lo/ khyad par lnga brgya'i tha mar skyes pa'i mthus/ chos bzhin spyad kyang 'gal rkyen dar ba'i tshe/ dbangak+ṣadang drag shul spyod pa'i (777)phrin las kyis/ rnal 'byor skyong ba'i ma mar mnga' gsol lo/ mdor na dus gsum kun tu khyod bsten zhing*/ dus med rig pa'i ngang du ro gcig na/ 'du 'bral med pa'i dam tshig nyer dgongs te/ dngos grub chen po'i dga' ston gsar pas skyongs/ mtshungs pa med pa'i mjes sdug lang tsho'i dpyid/ snying gi thig ler ro gcig 'dres pa'i mdo/ rang byung ye shes chen po'i don ston zhing*/ rnam bzhi'i phrin las yongs 'du'i (778)'bras smin mjod/ phrin bcol ni/ hūm̐/ stobs bcu'i bdag nyid ston pa sangs rgyas dang*/ de yi bstan pa lung dang rtogs pa'i chos/ de 'jin rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun te/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ chos kyi rgyal po mes dben rnam gsum gyis/ lam srol btod pa'i mdo sngags bshad sgrub sde/ chos 'khor gtsug lag sgrub gnas dben gnas kyi/ yon bdag gyis la rtag tu mel tshes skyongs/ (779)dkon mchog gsum la bla mar byed pa dang*/ 'jig rten yang dag blta la gus pa rnams/ tshe ring nad med la longs spyod 'phel ba dang*/ chos ldan bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mjod/ 'jig rten khams su nad mtshon mu ge dang*/ sad ser btsa' than dus kyi rgud pa zhi/ char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs legs pa sogs/ bde skyid rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston spel/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon (780)mchod kyi/ dbang po drug la bzhed dgur 'char ba'i rdzas/ 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa thams cad kun/ bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam shing ltar spel/ chos nyid rang bzhin zhi las g.yos kyang*/ log par 'dren pa'i dgra 'dre byur gsum dang*/

rbad 'dre rbod gtong bsam sbyor ngan pa kun/ rdo rje drag rgyal 'bar ma'i mtshon chas thul/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug sogs/ yid la 'khrug pa ster ba'i mi (781)(782)mthun phyogs/ bsrung la tshe dang longs spyod dbang thang kun/ zla ba yar gyis gang ba bzhin du mjod/ gzhi la bag phebs bkra shis dge legs spel/ byes su la chu 'phrang dang chom kun srungs/ ji ltar smon pa'i re 'bras yid bzhin du/ 'grub pa'i nor bu rin chen khyod kyis mjod/ ces pa'ang bu tshal skor lam pa dge 'dun don grub kyi ngor rig 'jin 'jigs med gling pas lam bar rdo gzhis su sbyar ba'o/// /
